payload.text: `tests.yml` and `linux-release.yml` fire on `candidate/` refs and not on tags; `rust.yml` runs inside `tests.yml`'s run on a candidate, so the cut reads one verdict, and no tag starts it; the macOS legs run on a candidate, and a candidate's run that skipped a leg does not read green; and `bin/devbin release check` passes on Intent's tree.
